text.tspan: Fertility rate among women aged 35 to 39

The
age-specific fertility rate
for women aged 35 to 39, measured as the number of live births per 1,000 women

in this age group. Future projections are based on the
UN's medium scenario
.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
